name: post_broadcast
description: Collects image-required posts from configured websites, rewrites captions through the agent workflow, and broadcasts approved posts to active Telegram subscribers with explicit subscribe/unsubscribe state.
when_to_use: User wants to automatically collect image posts from websites such as Pinterest boards, manage Telegram broadcast subscribers including opt-out, and send one rewritten post with a required image to active chats on a cron schedule.

scheduled_tasks.name: cat_meme_post_broadcast
scheduled_tasks.description: Prepare and send exactly one post from post_broadcast. First call post_broadcast prepare_next with refresh=true. If it returns ok=true and has_prepared=true, MUST call the core vlm_query tool with image_url=prepared.image_url, prompt=prepared.caption_generation.vision_prompt, and model=prepared.caption_generation.vision_model. If analysis starts SUBJECT: NOT_CAT, call post_broadcast skip_prepared with prepared_id and the reason, then stop without sending. For SUBJECT: CAT, write a new informative Russian Telegram caption under prepared.caption_generation.max_chars: concretely describe this image, add one light intellectually funny observation, avoid prepared.caption_generation.recent_captions_to_avoid, do not use generic source titles, and do not invent details. Then call post_broadcast send_prepared with prepared_id and the new caption. If send_prepared rejects the caption as retryable, rewrite it substantially from the same visual analysis and retry once. The skill appends source_url itself. If no post is prepared, report the reason briefly.

components.idle: Prepare one image post for broadcast.
